title: ARC UPDATE: 2nd Floor & Wall Building
summary: Check out the completion of flooring on level 2 and additional wall construction in our latest time lapse video from the Sierra ARC.
body_markdown:
We have another ARC Update video to share!


The Sierra ARC Building 1 upfit continues as we completed the floor on the 2nd level of the building, and have begun to raise additional walls in both the front and backside of the factory.


For more updates and photos, make sure to check out our[Sierra ARC webpage.](https://aquametals.com/sierra-arc-campus/)
